body: Observed while repairing PR379 at Corvint base4663ce7c and installed Core build163 (official v1.0.0-rc.1). docs/DOGFOOD.md523-525 permits an explicit reviewed exception for unknown/mechanical hunks, while internal/dogfoodflow/check.go rejects any nonempty DOGFOOD_EXCEPTION as exception-contract-undefined and strict coordinator uses only bootstrap allowance.
